title: SIT-Eval: Situation-Based Interactive Turn-by-Turn Evaluation of Conversational Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.23612v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The rapid proliferation of conversational AI agents necessitates evaluation methods that assess performance across diverse dialogue scenarios, utilizing multiple situational criteria, as appropriate behavior depends on context and encompasses various aspects. Existing dialogue benchmarks typically use static natural conversations, which underrepresent rare situations---a critical safety gap, as low-probability events become frequent failures at production scale. However, limited sample sizes force a choice: either maintain natural dialogues for realism or turn to adaptive situation sampling for comprehensive yet statistically reliable coverage. We introduce SIT-Eval, an adjustable framework for evaluating situation-based conversational agents. We formalize an agent's desired behavior as situational rules: if situation is P, follow rules Q. translated_title: SIT-Eval：基于情境的对话代理逐轮交互式评估
translated_abstract: 对话式AI代理的迅速普及，亟需能够在多样化对话场景中评估其性能的评估方法，并采用多种情境标准，因为恰当的行为取决于上下文并涉及多个方面。现有的对话基准通常使用静态的自然对话，这导致对罕见情境的代表性不足——这是一个关键的安全缺口，因为低概率事件在生产规模下会演变为频繁的故障。然而，有限的样本量迫使研究者做出取舍：要么维持自然对话以保证真实感，要么采用自适应情境采样以获得全面且在统计上可靠的覆盖。我们提出了SIT-Eval，一个用于评估基于情境的对话代理的可调节框架。我们将代理的期望行为形式化为情境规则：如果情境为P，则遵循规则Q。在每一轮对话中，一个LLM对话者扮演一个均匀采样的情境。
tldr: SIT-Eval提出了一个可调节的评估框架，将对话代理的期望行为形式化为“情境-规则”形式，并由LLM对话者在每轮对话中扮演随机采样的情境，从而实现对对话代理在多样化及罕见情境下的逐轮交互式评估，弥补了现有静态基准对罕见情境覆盖不足的安全缺口。
en_tdlr: SIT-Eval introduces an adjustable evaluation framework that formalizes an agent's desired behavior as situational rules ("if situation P, follow rules Q"), with an LLM interlocutor enacting uniformly sampled situations at each turn, enabling comprehensive turn-by-turn interactive evaluation of conversational agents across diverse and rare situations.
